C08-M02-L07-F1.title: A collection pipeline from source to rules, with health checks
C08-M02-L07-F1.caption: How Banyan's endpoint, network, server and cloud telemetry reaches the SIEM through different collectors, a buffer and a parser, watched by a source-health monitor.
C08-M02-L07-F1.alt: Graph diagram. Windows workstations (Security log, Sysmon) send events via WEF over WinRM to the Windows Event Collector. Network devices (firewall, proxy) push syslog over TLS to the Syslog relay. Linux servers are read by an Agent on host. Cloud and SaaS audit APIs are pulled over HTTPS by the API poller. The Windows Event Collector, Syslog relay, Agent on host and API poller all send events to the Buffer / message queue, which feeds Parse + normalise, which feeds SIEM storage, which feeds Rules, searches, dashboards. Dashed arrows from the Buffer / message queue (queue depth) and from SIEM storage (last seen, volume, parse errors) go to the Source-health monitor, which raises health alerts to the SOC queue.
C08-M02-L07-F1.note: Each hand-off can fail silently; the health monitor measures the pipeline itself.

C08-M02-L07-F2.title: Where telemetry is lost, and the check that notices
C08-M02-L07-F2.caption: Six loss points in a collection pipeline, the symptom each produces in the SIEM, and the health check that reveals it.
C08-M02-L07-F2.alt: Table with columns Stage, What fails, Symptom in the SIEM, Health check. Source: audit policy off or local log wraps; event types missing or gaps; field and event-type completeness. Agent / WEF: agent stopped or subscription lapsed; one host goes silent; last seen per host. Transport: UDP syslog drops or expired certificate; volume falls or traffic uninspected; hourly volume against baseline. Buffer / queue: disk full or queue overflows; lag rises, then loss; queue depth and ingestion lag. Parser: new or changed log format; events present but fields empty; parse-error count. Storage / index: retention too short or write fails; old data missing; retention and write-error checks.
rows: Audit policy off; local log wraps
C08-M02-L07-F2.note: Red rows fail without any error the SOC normally sees; each needs its own check.
